custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a part number for a new part, part A, that no part or Part Library entry uses yet.
  • Use a description, description 1, that no part or Part Library entry has.
  • Have a parts import file with two rows: the first with an empty part number and description 1, the second with part A's part number and a description of its own, each with quantity 1.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (click the box at the top right, then Settings, then Inventory under IMPORTS in the left menu; the page is titled Inventory Import Preview).

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573679-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573679-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • Settings: click the box at the top right, then Settings in its menu. The left menu then lists Staff, Roles & Permissions, Bin Locations and Categories, and Inventory under IMPORTS.
  • The inventory import page has Download Template (a file with the right columns), Select CSV File (to pick your file) and Submit File.
custom_steps:
1. Click Select CSV File and pick the file.
  2. Click Submit File.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  5. Type description 1 in the Search box.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type description 1 in the Part Library search.
  9. Click Parts in the top bar.
  10. Click Inventory in the left menu.
  11. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes, and no error or warning about the row with no part number appears.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 4:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 5:

  • No row is listed: the row with no part number was skipped.

Step 6:

  • No row is listed on the Inactive tab either.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • No entry has description 1.

Step 9:

  • The Parts left menu shows Inventory.

Step 10:

  • The Inventory page opens.

Step 11:

  • Part A is listed, with its own description: the other row of the same file was imported.
